# C-EQ 3.2 — Multiple speakers assistant

**Multiple speakers / Varios parlantes:** a new card that looks at your paired speakers and your phone and takes you to what actually works:
- **Same-brand party mode** if you have two or more of the same brand (Sony Party Connect, JBL PartyBoost / Auracast, UE PartyUp, Soundcore PartyCast, Marshall Stack Mode, Bose, Tribit), with a button to find the brand's app.
- **Audio sharing (Auracast)** if your phone can broadcast LE Audio: it works across brands with compatible speakers.
- **Dual audio** on Samsung phones.
- **AUX cable**, which always works.

Android doesn't let an app link speakers from different brands by itself (the phone's system or each speaker's firmware does that), so the assistant shows you the right path instead. The equalizer keeps working in all of them.

Una tarjeta nueva revisa tus parlantes vinculados y tu teléfono y te lleva a lo que sí funciona: el modo fiesta de la marca, Compartir audio (Auracast), Audio dual en Samsung o un cable AUX. El ecualizador sigue sonando en todas.
